name: Kabmo
description: Panels bundled with Kabmo, plus the ones you install from a git URL.

plugins.name: session-info
plugins.description: Shows the active workspace and keeps a note per session.

plugins.name: stats
plugins.description: CPU and RAM used by the omp stack — Kabmo, every omp child, the daemons and the shells.

plugins.name: command-runner
plugins.description: Lists a repository's commands and runs them, in the foreground or as background jobs.

plugins.name: git-forge
plugins.description: Reads and acts on a repository's issues, pull/merge requests and releases on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or Bitbucket.

plugins.name: github-actions
plugins.description: Monitors a repository's GitHub Actions runs: the list, each run's jobs and steps, job logs, and the cancel/re-run verbs.

plugins.name: kanban
plugins.description: A board that drives work: a card carries a prompt, an agent and a stage, and an agent moves its own cards through MCP.
